text:
Roman Kantserov came over from the KHL this season after 36 goals for Metallurg Magnitogorsk, and he's been the best news in Chicago. He has 9 goals in 18 games, goals in four straight and points in eight straight, while the Blackhawks won once in their last ten.

The goals are running ahead of the chances. Nine goals on 4.6 expected means he's shooting 29%, about double his likely range, and only 2 assists sit beside them. Chicago gets 39% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, which says the team is getting buried while he finishes what little it creates.

So what's real? The shot quality is fine and the role is big (18 and a half minutes a night for a 22-year-old rookie). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, eight games in, doesn't flag a clear strength or weakness yet. Forwards drafted where he went, in the 34 to 54 range, reach 200 NHL games less than a third of the time. Watch the shooting percentage: the goals will slow, and the question is what's left when they do.
headline: Roman Kantserov, the bright spot in a dark Chicago month
